## Why

The user goal this change serves, in plain language.

## What changed

What is different for the person or bot using this module, in plain language.

## Evidence

Paste the output of the checks you ran. For a change that touches behaviour, include `npm test`, `npm run check:schemas`, `npm run tlc`, and `npm run verify`. For a dependency change, include `npm audit` and `npm outdated`.

## Decisions

Choices made without asking, and why.
